resources.string: Detects when a protected app is opened so Phone Lock can ask for your fingerprint. It only checks which app is in front; nothing is collected, stored or sent.

Phone Lock needs its accessibility service to detect when locked apps open. Tap Enable, then turn on \"Phone Lock guard\".
If the switch is greyed out (Android 13+): open Settings › Apps › Phone Lock, tap the ⋮ menu and choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Apps switched on here ask for your fingerprint every time they are opened.

⚠ Root module not active – these apps will still show their last screen.
To make them black in recents like the camera app: open LSPosed › Modules › Phone Lock, turn it on, tick \"System Framework\" and \"Phone Lock\" in its list, then reboot.

✓ Root module active. Apps switched on here show a solid black card in recents, like the camera app. Screenshots and screen recordings of them are black too.
After switching an app on, close it and open it again once so the change applies.
Makes the apps you pick in Phone Lock show a black card in recent apps.
No fingerprint is enrolled on this device. Add one in Settings > Security to use app locks.
When should unlocked apps lock again?
As soon as I leave the app
A set time after I leave the app
Only when the screen turns off
Turning the screen off always locks every app again, whichever option is chosen.
